discovered_formats.input_data: TSV.XZ (XZ-compressed tab-separated values with 6 columns: filename, keys, text_djvu, text_tesseract, text_textract, text_best)
discovered_formats.labels: TSV (space-separated key=value pairs per line, one line per document)

document_counts.source: Counted from expected.tsv line counts (train/dev). Test count from repository README.

notes: This is a DOCUMENT-LEVEL information extraction task, NOT a clause-level classification task.
The repository contains 4 extraction keys (effective_date, jurisdiction, party, term), NOT 14 clause categories.
No clause segmentation or clause-level annotations are present in this repository.
The [INIT_CLAUSE]/[END_CLAUSE] annotation format described in the reference paper does NOT exist here.
The reference paper's 3,714-clause dataset with 14 categories appears to be a DERIVED dataset created by the paper's authors.
The paper reports 322 documents; the repository contains 540 (254+83+203). The paper may have used a subset.
test-A labels (expected.tsv) are hidden and not available in the public repository.
726 PDFs exist in documents/ but only 540 are referenced across the three splits.
The original data must remain untouched in external_data/kleister-nda/.
Dataset conversion into the project's format should NOT proceed until the gap with the paper is resolved.
